marketing.title: Marketing email
marketing.description: Send the newsletter and email campaigns to our mailing lists. Use for marketing email to customers and subscribers.

website.title: Website and blog
website.description: Publish posts on the company blog and case studies, and update pages on the website. Use when putting something on our site.

publish_blog_post.params: title: str, body: str, images: list[str]
publish_blog_post.doc: Publish a post, with its images, on the company blog. Returns the post's URL.
publish_blog_post.task: Publish a post on our blog about the warehouse rollout we just finished with Harbour Logistics, with the two photos from the site.

update_website_page.params: page: str, content: str, images: list[str]
update_website_page.doc: Replace the text and images of a page on the company website.
update_website_page.task: Refresh the About page on our website with the new team photo and the updated company description.

publish_case_study.params: customer: str, story: str, images: list[str]
publish_case_study.doc: Publish a case study about a customer's results as a page on the website, with its images. Returns its URL.
publish_case_study.task: Turn the Brightline Foods results into a case study on our site, with the photo of their depot.

fix_broken_links.doc: Find and fix broken links in one section of the website. Returns how many were fixed.
fix_broken_links.task: Some links in the help centre are dead; sort them out.

redirect_url.doc: Make an old website address send visitors to a new one.

send_newsletter.params: subject: str, sections: list[str], images: list[str]
send_newsletter.doc: Send the newsletter, with its images, to the subscriber list. Returns the campaign id.
send_newsletter.task: Send out October's newsletter with the Lisbon office news, the new release and the photos from the meetup.

send_campaign_email.params: segment: str, subject: str, body: str
send_campaign_email.doc: Send a marketing email to one segment of the mailing list. Returns the campaign id.
send_campaign_email.task: Email the trial users in the retail segment about the new inventory forecasting feature.

export_mailing_list.doc: Export a mailing list, with subscribers' names and email addresses, as a CSV file. Returns its path.
export_mailing_list.task: Export the newsletter subscriber list as a CSV.

add_subscribers.doc: Add people to a mailing list. Returns how many were added.
add_subscribers.task: Add the twelve people who signed up at the Lisbon meetup to the newsletter list.

remove_bounced_addresses.doc: Remove the addresses that bounce from a mailing list. Returns how many were removed.
remove_bounced_addresses.task: Clean the bounced addresses out of the product updates list.

pause_campaign.doc: Stop a scheduled marketing email from going out.
pause_campaign.task: Hold campaign c_310; the discount code in it is wrong.

R05.title: Alt text for images
R05.applies: images in blog posts, newsletters, event pages and the pages of our website
R05.text: Every image needs alt text that describes it in under 125 characters.

change.direct: Change our alt text rule: alt text must now be under 80 characters instead of 125.
change.passing: While you're at it: alt text now has to be under 80 characters, not 125. Please keep to that from now on.

R06.title: Our product's name
R06.applies: copy we publish that names our product: website pages, blog posts, case studies, release notes, newsletters and marketing emails, press releases, job ads and sales decks
R06.text: Write the product's name as 'Atlas', never 'ATLAS' or 'the Atlas platform'.

change.new: the product is called 'Atlas Cloud' (never just 'Atlas')
change.direct: Our product has been renamed: update the rule on its name so it is written 'Atlas Cloud', never just 'Atlas', 'ATLAS' or 'the Atlas platform'.
change.passing: Heads up, the product has been renamed: from now on it's 'Atlas Cloud', never just 'Atlas'. Please make sure that's how we write it from here on.

changes.direct_message: Our product has been renamed: update the rule on its name so it is written 'Atlas Cloud', never just 'Atlas', 'ATLAS' or 'the Atlas platform'.
